public_payloads: tools, source identities, hashes, metadata and tests only

modern_source.rights: Audio copyright The Pokemon Company; repository CC0 does not change this

pilot_gate: 12-species comparative listening before approving the 386-species modern pack
original_baseline: pinned Emerald source PCM; hardware engine rendering not yet certified
cry_variants: cry.{national_dex}.mode.{0..12}; require exact preprocessed or authored mode, no normal-mode substitution
loop: integer decoded PCM frame positions; locally authored loop asset must be runtime verified

concurrency.policy: drop new lowest-priority or replace oldest lower-priority; completed components removed

lifecycle: background/focus loss pauses active components and blocks new playback; resume only after both clear; detach on shutdown
authority: presentation only; no RNG, battle mutation, audio-duration wait completion or core asset paths
missing: return explicit failure; optional same-semantic-ID original profile fallback only
ai: optional offline experiment after pilot; not enabled or required
runtime_gates: Android cook, focus callback attachment, latency and memory
